dungeon: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied ORIGINAL approved sprite sheet into an animation atlas. Highest priority: preserve its ROUGH COARSE BIG-PIXEL texture. It must look hand-drawn at only 24-32 logical pixels per character, enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Every outline stair and highlight is a visibly LARGE square block about 7-9 output pixels wide; no small fine pixels, antialiasing, soft edges, gradients, smooth curves, rendered volume or vector-like outlines. Use 2-3 flat shades per material with large jagged irregular clusters. This is coarse retro game art, not high resolution pixel illustration. Keep original character designs, palette, accessories, proportions, and softened material-colored outlines. No added glow. Output transparent PNG 1024x1280, EXACT FOUR columns FIVE rows =20 sprites, regular grid. Each cell256x256, art centered in inner176x176 with40px transparent padding each side; huge empty transparent gutters; no art touches neighbors. Within each row identical body size and stable body anchor and feet baseline; poses differ only for intended animation. No labels, lines, frames, shadows or background. Exclude sixth-row boss. FOUR clearly distinct temporal poses per creature that loop 0-1-2-3-0. Keep ALL details at the same coarse chunky grid, including weapons, ears, feet, chains and cloth. Rows: 1 gray cave bat pink wings red eyes, four flight phases wings raised / outward horizontal descending / folded low / horizontal ascending, torso stays steady. 2 gray-brown rat facing LEFT pink ears feet tail: four distinct scamper phases alternating diagonal pairs, clear front/back foot placement, tail follows. 3 white hooded chain ghost black face with small white eyes, two rusty cuffs and dangling chains: four gentle floating phases with jagged hem curling and chain lag, preserve hood design. 4 beige-gray stone spider violet rune magenta eyes: four alternating-leg crawl phases with very obvious chunky separated legs lifted/reaching/planted; shell remains stable. 5 gray haunted armor small pink eye slit blue waistcloth rusty orange sword in left of image: four clear walking phases left contact/pass/right contact/pass, boots separated, small coordinated sword/arm swing, preserve shape. Do NOT increase detail or smooth the source: match or EXCEED the source's coarse block size.
